scope: Durable peer receipts, provider completion/compaction validation, incremental SSE framing. No layout changes.

sse_batch_benchmark.scope: Decoder only; assertions check event count and Unicode payload. Shared host; not network/model/rendering latency or a hard upper bound.

checks: Confirmed outgoing acceptance survives a late failed attempt and database reopen.
Incomplete, empty and tool-bearing compaction replies preserve opaque context and unknown fields across reopen.
Claude rejects unfinished/repeated blocks, deltas after block stop and missing stop reason; valid tools and unknown future events succeed.
Both providers reject duplicate/empty tool IDs and non-object arguments.
Peer receipts require matching immutable identity and admission state; recipient-edited text remains valid.
SSE framing preserves Unicode and CRLF across chunks of 1, 2, 3, 7, 31, 4096 bytes and a complete batch; reuse succeeds.
limits: The prior live Claude reasoning/compaction attempt returned HTTP 429; no further quota-consuming attempt made in this audit.
No new visual sweep: GUI and TUI drawing/layout are unchanged; preceding 90-case sweep is recorded in coder-reliability-qa.json.
Finite automated tests do not establish zero defects or a weeks-long live soak.
